intent: Unapproved animation concepts; parent curation precedes user review

specs.prompt: Edit the supplied sprite reference into a NEW eight-frame pixel-art animation proposal sheet, 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, actual transparent background. Use ONLY the young Sasuke sprite identity from this reference: blue short sleeve shirt, white shorts, blue shinobi sandals, black spiky hair, blue forehead protector, lean Nintendo DS-era proportions, approximately 1 head to 3.5 body heights, no chibi redesign. No source title, no reference sheet background, no text or grid lines. Every cell one complete full body, feet same baseline, generous separate empty gutters and no cropped effects. Eight successive poses read left to right: preparing with hands together, deep concentration, right-hand yellow-blue lightning ignition near hip, leaning forward with charged hand drawn back, forceful forward Chidori thrust with arm extending right and trailing lightning, sharp impact white-blue burst beyond fingertips, fast follow-through with a restrained afterimage, stable recovery stance. Crisp hand-placed-looking pixel clusters, black outlines, restricted colors, consistent body size and recognizable source identity. This is a REVIEW sprite concept, not an illustration poster. Improve anticipation, charged-hand placement and thrust silhouette over using a generic jutsu pose. Keep all frames facing RIGHT. Never giant head, soft painted anime, photorealism, extra arms, swords or other characters.

Edit the supplied sprite reference into a NEW eight-frame pixel-art fireball casting proposal sheet, 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, genuinely transparent background, no titles labels or grid lines. Preserve ONLY original young Sasuke visual identity from the reference: blue shirt, white shorts, black spiky hair, blue headband, lean Nintendo DS pixel-sprite proportions and black outline. Do not redesign his body or outfit. Each equal cell has one full Sasuke facing RIGHT, feet aligned and same scale, clear empty gutters. Sequence: upright preparation, compact two-hand seal at chest, chest expansion/head tilts slightly back to inhale, cheeks and torso brace with a tiny orange flame exactly at the MOUTH, short broad orange fire jet from mouth extending right, large round orange-red fireball with bright yellow interior separating to the right while caster leans back, diminishing mouth flame and braced recovery, neutral ready stance. The fireball grows outward naturally; origin MUST be mouth, never hands or belly. Keep effect completely within its own cell. Crisp limited-palette pixel art matching the supplied DS sprite, readable anticipation and follow-through. Avoid huge chibi head, painted high-resolution anime, dragon-shaped fire, weapons, duplicated limbs, background colors.

Use ONLY the small young NARUTO sprites in the LEFT section of the supplied Team7 sheet as identity/style reference, and create a NEW eight-cell pixel-art shadow-clone animation proposal sheet, 4 columns by 2 rows on an actual transparent background, no text/title/grid. Exclude Sakura, Kakashi and all portrait illustrations. Naruto wears orange-and-blue original-series clothing, blue forehead protector, blond spiky hair, compact lean Nintendo DS-era sprite proportions, consistent body shape and black pixel outline; do not use the black-and-orange Shippuden costume. Each cell is a clear full-body composition with aligned ground and generous empty gutters. Read sequence left to right: ready Naruto, hands forming the crossed-finger clone seal at chest, held seal with small chakra puffs, a ring of chunky white smoke begins; second row: a second matching Naruto steps out of smoke, several matching clones emerge in a semicircle, a small readable formation of exactly eight Narutos including center caster with consistent appearance, forward melee assault with caster remaining behind. Use tiny clearly separated full figures when many clones are present, no overlaid body parts. Use thick readable pixel smoke curls and tight limited palette, no soft airbrush. Focus on purposeful body posture and smoke-to-clone staging rather than changing character design.

Use ONLY small young NARUTO sprites from LEFT section of supplied Team7 sheet to create a NEW eight-frame 4-column by 2-row pixel-art Rasengan action proposal on actual transparent background. No labels, grid, title, portrait art, Sakura or Kakashi. Preserve Naruto's original-series orange-and-blue outfit, blue headband, blond spiky hair, black outline and lean DS sprite proportions, full body same scale and feet aligned throughout. All action faces RIGHT. Sequence: brace feet and cup right hand beside hip, left hand assists a tiny cyan chakra sphere above right palm, sphere becomes a tight bright rotating blue-white ball with several explicit curved spin bands, caster leans forward keeping sphere at hand, powerful right-hand palm thrust with compact cyan sphere touching invisible target to right, round white-cyan spiraling impact expanding only in front, forward follow-through with curling residual wind and readable legs, recovery. Art must match original small limited-palette pixel clusters; restrained bright cyan effects with darker blue contour, no giant energy planet, no beam, no sword, no extra limbs, no oversized chibi head, no soft painted illustration. Leave enough transparent spacing between all cells and contain effects within each cell.

Edit this proposed Sasuke action sheet to fix ONLY the Chidori action choreography, preserving its young blue-shirt white-shorts Sasuke pixel identity, exact face and body proportions, crisp pixel clusters, and 4-column 2-row sheet layout. Actual transparent background, no text. The attack is canonically held in Sasuke's LEFT hand: maintain the SAME anatomical LEFT charged hand continuously from charging to thrust; the RIGHT hand assists at the left wrist during charge then pulls back near chest for balance. Do not switch hands between poses. Eight successive full body frames all facing RIGHT: prepare stance; left palm LOW near left hip and right hand near left wrist; compact blue-white forked lightning ONLY around low LEFT palm; body lunges with charged left arm drawn back; left palm thrusts forward RIGHT while right fist stays at chest; compact impact branching ONLY just beyond left fingertips (not giant flash covering torso); follow-through with sparse blue afterimage; recovery and small residual spark. Keep charged hand and lightning entirely inside each cell. One sprite per equal cell, same feet baseline and size; generous separate gutters. No bent beam, no energy cone, no backwards lightning before charging, no extra hands, no fullbody yellow aura, no effects crossing grid cells. We want a readable animation candidate, not a poster.

STRICT 4 columns by2 rows on actual transparent background, eight equal separate cells with empty gutters. Preserve original orange-and-blue suit, blue headband, lean Nintendo DS proportions: head only one quarter total height, legs visibly long, no chibi redesign.
